content:
devon: quick q — when we add a new optional field `tool_binding` inside message.payload, should older clients treat unknown keys as opaque extras (i.e., ignore), or do we need a strict whitelist to avoid subtle breakage?

maria: ignore unknown keys. that’s been our compatibility rule for the messages schema since the first convo contract. optional fields allowed.

aj: confirm — we should still ensure enums are backward-compatible (no reordering or renaming). adding keys is fine but not changing meanings. also we should add a lint rule to catch enum changes.

samir: also a streaming nuance: how do we emit function/tool call fragments? current pattern is start -> arg chunks -> end. older clients reassemble by concatenation. example we currently emit: 
```
{ "type": "delta", "delta": { "event": "tool_call_start", "tool": "search", "args": null } }
{ "type": "delta", "delta": { "event": "tool_call_arg_chunk", "chunk": "{\"q\": \"redwood inference\"}" } }
{ "type": "delta", "delta": { "event": "tool_call_end", "args": "{\"q\": \"redwood inference\"}" } }
```

samir: older clients should concatenate the `chunk` pieces then parse final `args` if present. if we plan to change this ordering, that is breaking.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: noted — tagging convo-contract owners for documentation update.

tao: small edge case: if a client relies on seeing tool_call_start before any content token, they might break if we start emitting partial tokens inline. recommend we document ordering guarantees explicitly + add `event_id` on deltas for robust reassembly.

devon: good call. i'll add streaming e2e tests that assert: 1) start -> any number of arg_chunk -> end, 2) unknown fields are ignored by older clients, 3) enums unchanged.

aj: i'll open two PRs: one for the linter rule (enum mutation warning) and one to add the recommended doc snippet and example above to convo-schema.md.

maria: please ping me in the PR, aj. i'll author the docs blurb + changelog entry (short, example-based).

devon: thanks everyone. once aj opens PRs i'll drop a quick checklist into the ticket. :thumbsup:

maria: one more — for private deployments we might want to gate new fields behind a feature flag propagation so on-prem clients can opt-in during upgrades. will add note in docs.

devon: agree — add `compat_feature: tool_binding_v1` to rollout plan.

aj: opened draft PR #4827 (linter) and #4828 (docs). tagging reviewers @maria @devon.

devon: great, closing loop. if anyone sees a case where parsing unknown fields failed in a shipped client, drop repro here. otherwise i'll add the e2e tests tomorrow.
